SQL_INJECTION.evidence: SQL-related syntax detected in a URL component.

XSS.evidence: Browser-executable markup or event-handler syntax was detected.

DIRECTORY_TRAVERSAL.evidence: Path traversal sequences target files outside the expected directory.

COMMAND_INJECTION.evidence: A shell-style command separator or substitution marker was detected.

LFI.evidence: A local-file inclusion style path appeared in an input parameter.

RFI.evidence: An include-like parameter references a remote resource.

WEB_SHELL_REFERENCE.evidence: The request references a filename commonly associated with web-shell telemetry.

WEB_SHELL_UPLOAD.evidence: A multipart upload references a server-executable script filename.

XXE_INDICATOR.evidence: XML external-entity declaration syntax was detected.

OPEN_REDIRECT.evidence: A redirect-style parameter points to an absolute external URL.

SCANNER_ACTIVITY.evidence: The request probes a path commonly seen in automated reconnaissance.
